description: Unambiguous source and deployment-role contract for the owner-open product entrypoint. It selects the v5 transport as the only product-facing executable, the v7 core as its internal child, and explicitly forbids the foundation UnavailableProvider binary from product installation.

non_product_binaries.reason: The foundation binary intentionally reports provider_unavailable and is not the selected provider/tool/job product topology.

source_acceptance: The exact product and internal child bins exist at the contracted source paths.
The product entrypoint usage requires a provider path and forwards core options.
The default child path resolves to the contracted v7 core sibling.
The foundation UnavailableProvider binary is marked non-product and forbidden in product inventories.
The deployment manifest template binds paths, hashes, argv, identity, namespaces, cgroup, sockets, stores, SELinux, restart and emergency stop.
